review:
Gem Elevator is a 6x5 cluster slot set deep underground, where five or more adjacent jewels form a win. Its signature feature is the elevator nudge: after every spin, the reels can randomly nudge up or down to create more winning combinations.

Wilds that land during nudges carry random multipliers from 1x to 10x. Four, five or six bonus symbols trigger free spins. The RTP is 96.53%, and no max win is published on the page. The nudges make each spin feel like it might still turn into a win after the reels stop.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
